purchaseFundingTiming.investorFund: Commit/lock the full approved allocation against the purchase immediately, even when seller cash paid is zero.
purchaseFundingTiming.companyRunningCapital: Record the full approved purchase allocation at creation; this allocation alone creates no Cash/Bank movement.
purchaseFundingTiming.sellerPayable: Derived from the approved corrected purchase cost minus valid actual seller installments plus actual seller refunds linked to the same Purchase; it is not a separate funding source or mutable balance. Reject a correction while net seller-paid value exceeds corrected cost until the excess has actually been refunded and recorded.
purchaseFundingTiming.cashMovement: One Accounting Cash/Bank movement only for each actual seller payment.

purchaseCorrection.entryMode: The authorized Accountant manually initiates the actual seller refund and the related Vehicle Purchase cost correction as separate records; both explicitly link to the same Purchase. A cost correction never automatically creates or implies a refund.
purchaseCorrection.refundEvidence: Record a seller refund only after cash is actually returned and the corresponding Accounting cash receipt is entered; do not create Company Income or Profit from the refund.
purchaseCorrection.payableDerivation: Outstanding seller payable is derived as corrected purchase cost minus valid actual installments plus actual linked seller refunds; keep no independently mutable payable total.
purchaseCorrection.belowPaidInstallments: Reject a purchase-cost correction that is below cumulative actual seller installments until the seller has actually refunded the excess and Accounting has recorded the receipt.
purchaseCorrection.history: Keep original purchase, installment, and Cash/Bank movement records immutable; append audited correction/allocation history.
purchaseCorrection.fundingSourceReduction: Reduce Investor Fund and Company Running Capital source allocations in the same proportion as the recorded purchase source split; preserve FIFO attribution within Investor Fund.
purchaseCorrection.rounding: Use high-precision proportional calculations, ROUND_HALF_UP to two decimals, then balance residual paise to exact total; ties use Investor Fund first, then Company Running Capital.
purchaseCorrection.remainingTechnicalContract: Design typed Accounting refund linkage, correction/reallocation records, transaction validation, idempotency, and migration dependencies before implementation.
